notes: A webcam set to Fill & crop is sharp on the 9:16 canvas. The camera now crops the part that shows at its full resolution and scales only that to the canvas, instead of shrinking the whole picture to 1080p and stretching a narrow slice of it. Pick the camera's 4K mode to get the most out of it: the Mode list marks it "full detail in Fill", and a newly added camera starts in its largest smooth mode. Moving or resizing the camera re-crops it about half a second after you let go.
